about: Shared typed-feedback fixtures (ADRs 0079 to 0081), read by crates/openblog-core/tests/scholarly_feedback.rs and tests/web/passage-feedback.test.mjs. A case's JSON text is its `text`, or its `submission` written compactly. `storedRow` is a row as the hosted database returns it and `hostedItem` the moderation item the hosted function makes of it.

accepted.name: a suggested source for the whole post, with a published name and the time it was seen
a suggested correction of a section, with wording, evidence on an international host, and a reader clock running ahead
another interpretation with a private name and null optional fields
a blank name is anonymous, and a byte-order mark is text, not whitespace
the longest body
